topic: J. Ridley Stroop (1935) Automatic Interference, 8-Day Reverse Practice, and Anterior Cingulate Conflict Monitoring (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Stroop's 1935 stopwatch test replicated over 700 times and guiding modern cockpit human-factors design and ACC brain mapping.

clips.attire_and_hands: wool vest suit sleeves and cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hands over a cool slate-stone bench
clips.prop_action: cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hands set down a grid tray of nested geometric tokens where muted-coral outer triangle frames hold contrasting powder-blue inner blocks
clips.consequence: rows of clashing dual-hue nested tokens sit beside a brushed-silver stopwatch

clips.environment: a sunlit cool mist-white psychology classroom with two upright slate-stone easel grids and brushed-silver stopwatch stands

clips.attire_and_hands: sage-green sweater cuffs and cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hands hovering over pastel sorting slots
